decisions.reason: Unified ready dispatch path; most instruction deltas are negligible. No speedup claim.
Regression reproduces an execution future being repolled after Pending without a wake. Preserve per-operation readiness.
More accurate refunding did not reduce measured work or establish a native gain; exclude the additional scheduler behavior change.

Fewer socket reads/writes, but 40–57% higher native service-chain means than the frozen previous portable in the drain campaign. Broad draining delays cross-hop overlap; causal attribution is provisional.
Callback client instructions increased 3.97% versus drain while server decreased 1.24%. No demonstrated total-work or latency gain. Broad batching regressions remained.
Unqualified guard-only attempt; outgoing observer ownership still blocks Driver::take_output. Not compiled or benchmarked.

Preserve parked readiness across descriptor-free hosted admission and output-capacity recovery. Both targeted regressions reproduce excess polls before fixes; all 336 RPC and 9 transport tests pass. Full native campaign has 13/24 mean-and-median C++ passes, equal to the frozen baseline; three concurrent service-chain means improve 6.0%, 14.1%, and 6.5%, with mixed results elsewhere.
